ambient: The front of the room handles something without consulting you.
You almost put a hand up. The intention arrives at the back of the room and stops there.
description: You have been moved to the back of your own life, and it's carrying on very competently without you. Your body is up at the front doing the necessary things. From here you can see that it's good at them, and that it doesn't need watching.
name: The Back Of The Room

looks: Getting on with it. Its posture is better than you would have guessed.
It does something with its hands that you didn't authorise and that was correct.
It hasn't looked back once, and there's no reason it should.
objects.name: your body, up at the front

looks: Not far. Not crossable. Those are different things and you have time to consider it.
It's the length of a room and it's the length of an afternoon.
It doesn't increase, which is a kindness.
objects.name: the distance to the front

weather: The air at the back is cooler and doesn't circulate, the way it's at the back of any long room.
